Authenticates with email/password and stores access_token in the active environment.

Requests a password reset link for an email/password account. Google-authenticated accounts return 409 with provider=google. Copy the token from Mailtrap or local logs into password_reset_token before calling Reset Password.
Validates whether a password reset token is still usable before showing the change-password form. Returns status=valid, invalid, or expired. A token becomes invalid after it is used once.
Changes the password using the one-time token from the reset email. The token is consumed after a successful password change and cannot be reused.
Redirect endpoint used by password reset emails. It forwards the reset query params to the configured admin reset-password page.
Changes the password for the authenticated email/password account and sends a confirmation email. Google-authenticated accounts return 409 with provider=google.
Returns the authenticated user's login history from newest to oldest. Use per_page=10 for the admin security screen pagination.

Creates an email/password user, sends a verification email, and stores email, password, and verification_user_id in the active environment. The user cannot sign in until the verification link is opened. Copy the token from the local logs or Mailtrap into verification_token to test Verify Email.
Verifies an email signup account. Use the token from the verification email or local Laravel log. Add redirect=1 only when testing browser redirection to the admin sign-in screen.
Creates or syncs a user through Google OAuth. Requires a real Google access token.
Signs in an existing Google user. Requires a real Google access token.
Revokes all tokens for the authenticated user.
Returns the authenticated user. Requires token ability: user:read.
Returns configurable notification preferences for the authenticated user. Mandatory auth emails are not exposed as opt-out preferences. Requires token ability: user:read.
Updates configurable notification preferences for the authenticated user. Only keys defined in config/notifications.php are accepted. Requires token ability: user:write.

request.description: Lists authenticated user notifications and logs, excluding dismissed items. Supports kind/read filters and returns most recent first. Requires token ability: user:read.

query.description: Returns only unread notifications visible in the top bell.

request.description: Lists unread actionable notifications shown in the top bell. Logs and read items are excluded. Requires token ability: user:read.

request.description: Marks one owned notification as read and returns it localized. Requires token ability: user:write.
Marks all owned, non-dismissed notifications as read. Add ?scope=bell to mark only items visible in the top bell. Requires token ability: user:write.

query.description: Marks only unread top-bell notifications as read.

request.description: Marks top-bell notifications as read without deleting them from the notification center. Requires token ability: user:write.
Dismisses one owned notification and removes it from the notification list. Requires token ability: user:write.

Lists users with profile, source, avatar, voice, AI media, and chat counts. The response includes active assignable subscription plans, including admin; inactive plans are omitted. Requires the authenticated user to have role admin.
Returns one user with profile summaries and resource counts. Requires the authenticated user to have role admin.

Assigns an active assignable subscription plan to admin_user_id. Use admin_subscription_plan=admin for the unlimited USD 0 admin grant; inactive plans are rejected. Requires the authenticated user to have role admin.
Creates an admin impersonation token for admin_user_id and stores it as admin_impersonation_token. Requires the authenticated user to have role admin.
Deletes the current admin impersonation token. This request uses admin_impersonation_token instead of access_token.

Cancels a current free trial at period end. Access stays active until trial_ends_at and no automatic trial conversion charge is attempted. Requires token ability: payments:create.
Cancels automatic renewal for an active paid recurring subscription. Access stays active until renews_at. Requires token ability: payments:create.
Reactivates a subscription or trial that was cancelled at period end before it expires. Requires token ability: payments:create.

request.description: Gets the cached current USD/COP exchange rate used by billing. Requires token ability: payments:read.
Gets one payment order owned by the authenticated user, or any order when authenticated as admin. Requires token ability: payments:read.

Local webhook endpoint for Wompi events. For manual Postman testing, set wompi_events_secret to the local WOMPI_EVENTS_SECRET value, run Create Wompi Checkout first, then send this request. The sample payload includes payment_source_id so the backend can store the reusable payment source for recurring subscriptions. The pre-request script computes X-Event-Checksum as SHA256(transaction.id + transaction.status + transaction.amount_in_cents + timestamp + WOMPI_EVENTS_SECRET).

request.description: Lists profiles that belong to the authenticated user. Requires token ability: profile:read.
Creates a profile and stores profile_id from data.id. New profiles default to status draft.
Retrieves the profile identified by profile_id.
Retrieves a profile by alias. Requires profile:read and does not validate profile ownership.
Lists supported social network keys, display names, and public S3 icon URLs. Requires token ability: profile:read.

Uploads an audio recording, transcribes it, and returns text plus field limit metadata for description/personality. Requires token ability: profile:transcribe. Set profile_transcription_audio_file_path to a local audio file such as webm, mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, or flac. profile_transcription_field should be description or personality.
Lists the profile's configurable conversation messages: initial greeting and fallback when the AI cannot answer. Requires token ability: profile:read.
Updates greeting/fallback texts. If a cloned active voice exists and no recorded audio is present, the API attempts to generate missing audio automatically. Requires token ability: profile:write.
Generates audio for initial or fallback_no_answer using the active cloned voice. Requires token ability: voice:use.
Uploads a manually recorded audio for initial or fallback_no_answer. The matching text must already be enabled. Requires token ability: profile:write.
Removes the saved audio for initial or fallback_no_answer without deleting the text. Requires token ability: profile:write.

Lists selectable profile profession templates, including developer and model. Requires token ability: profile:read.
Lists imported knowledge sources for a profile. Requires token ability: profile:read.

Imports a CV file and/or pasted CV text as a profile knowledge source. Requires token ability: profile:write. If the parser cannot extract PDF text, paste profile_cv_text so facts can be created immediately.

request.description: Streams the original file attached to an imported profile source for preview or download. Requires token ability: profile:read.
Approves and indexes an imported profile source plus its generated items and facts. Requires token ability: profile:write.
Lists profile facts with default pagination of 20. Optional query params: category, approved, indexed, page, per_page. Requires token ability: profile:read.
Updates a generated profile fact. Setting indexed=true also approves the fact. Requires token ability: profile:write.
Returns quality score, checks, and counts for profile knowledge readiness. Requires token ability: profile:read.

Lists chats for profile_id, ordered by last update descending and paginated by 20. Includes api/openai message counts and last_message_at. Requires chat:read. Admin users can read any profile; non-admin users can only read their own profiles.

Lists chats for the profile route parameter, ordered by last update descending and paginated by 20. This covers GET /api/profile/{profile}/chats. Requires chat:read. Admin users can read any profile; non-admin users can only read their own profiles.

Lists messages for chat_id within profile_id, ordered chronologically and paginated by 20. Requires chat:read. Admin users can read any profile; non-admin users can only read their own profiles. The chat must belong to the profile.
Creates a new chat for the profile when chat_id is omitted.

request.description: Sends a message to an existing chat. Run 'Send Message - New Chat' first to populate chat_id. Chat answers are limited to 200 characters and can include a media array when the profile attaches a selected integration photo.

Exercises AI-inferred media constraints for selected integration media. The AI returns provider/source constraints, and the backend validates attached media against those constraints. If the profile only has excluded photos, the response should not include media and should say no matching photo is available. If other providers exist, the backend can attach one of those instead.

request.description: Uploads an audio recording, transcribes it, creates a new chat when chat_id is omitted, and sends the transcribed text as a message. Requires messages:write. The response includes request_text and request_audio_url for the stored user audio message. Set message_audio_file_path to a local audio file such as webm, mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, or flac. Browser recordings in WebM/MP4 containers are accepted.

Uploads an audio recording to an existing chat, transcribes it, stores the audio URL on the message, and sends the transcribed text. The response includes request_text and request_audio_url for the stored user audio message. Browser recordings in WebM/MP4 containers are accepted. Run 'Send Message - New Chat' or 'Send Audio Message - New Chat' first to populate chat_id.
Creates a voice for the selected profile and stores voice_id from data.id. If the profile already has an active voice, the existing voice is returned. A profile can only have one active voice.
Updates the selected voice metadata. Requires voice:write and ownership of the voice, or an admin/api role.
Uploads an audio file for a voice. Set voice_sample_file_path in the environment to a local mp3 or wav path.
Starts processing a voice sample. This can call external voice provider code depending on configuration.
Generates test audio using the active voice for the selected profile. Requires voice:use ability.

Uploads a source image and starts avatar generation for the selected profile. Requires avatar:write. Non-admin users can only generate avatars for their own profiles; admins can generate for any profile. Set avatar_image_file_path to a local jpg, png, or webp image.
Gets the active avatar for profile_id. Requires avatar:read.

Lists previous avatars for profile_id, including active_avatar, processing_avatar, and all avatar rows ordered by latest update. Requires avatar:read. Non-admin users can only read their own profiles; admins can read any profile.

Activates a previous avatar for profile_id and marks the previously active avatar inactive. Requires avatar:write. Returns 409 while a generation is processing and 422 when the selected avatar is not selectable.
